question: Which complete downstream attention or MLP modules causally mediate the confirmed H3 rank-eight behavioral intervention?

prior_art_search.lesson: The original writer response atlas ranked patched-in sufficiency responses and found attention9/11/15 plus an opposing MLP17. The new intervention instead removes each live response generated specifically by confirmed rank-eight H3 actuation. The L15 necessity null proves that response transport is not evidence of behavioral mediation.

frozen_design.population: All 31 A1 and 32 A2 jointly capable rows from sealed v10.
frozen_design.upstream_intervention: Install the exact tensor-derived rank-eight projection of the live L8H1-induced H3 response at every causal position.
frozen_design.singleton_removal: For each site, dynamically restore its complete output under H3 rank-eight actuation to the native-base output at every position through the answer query.
frozen_design.joint_removal: Restore all thirteen site outputs together while leaving the H3 rank-eight intervention and residual skip path live.
frozen_design.controls: An unclamped rank-eight arm must replay its confirmation receipt; restoring every site during a native-base self-clamp must preserve the native logits.

predictions.pred_a_authority_exact_replay_self_clamp: All authority hashes, tensor reconstructions, rank-eight replay, native all-site self-clamp, finite complete coverage, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_at_least_one_stable_material_modu: At least one identical module removes at least 10% in absolute value of rank-eight behavior in both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_c_mlp17_is_stable_largest_absolute_: MLP17 is the largest-absolute singleton removal in both constructions, following the signed late correction in the original-writer atlas.
predictions.pred_d_mlp17_is_opposing: Restoring MLP17 increases the rank-eight behavioral effect in both constructions, so its signed removal fraction is negative.

decision: Exactness failure is invalid. Stable material singleton mediation is a screen and licenses within-module splitting. If no singleton reaches 10% but the joint removal reaches 20%, classify distributed_downstream and run prospective greedy combinations. If even joint removal is below 20%, classify residual_route and trace the persistent residual/unembedding path rather than optimizing another subspace.
